messages:
mina: just opened PR #1432 — js-sdk: streaming backpressure + rest-client toolcall header merge fix. Needs review/approval for merge window today. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1432 :eyes:

sam: on it, will skim now. can you paste the failing test stack you saw?

mina: thanks — reproducer is in the PR description. failing with `RangeError: invalid chunk size` under heavy load. added unit + e2e stub.

taylor: left two inline comments about `mergeHeaders` order and an example where toolcall metadata gets overwritten. Also feel free to split the header refactor into its own patch if that's easier.

ben: I can take the streaming perf diff after lunch. is there a simple script to run locally? If not I can wire one up.

mina: added `scripts/bench_streaming.sh` to the branch. run with `NODE_ENV=test node scripts/bench_streaming.js` — it's lightweight.

sam: quick note — tests failing on node 16 CI matrix. looks like `ReadableStream` poly mismatch. pushing a small shim suggestion now.

taylor: after sam's shim, tests are green for me. :thumbsup: I'm happy to approve once CI finishes. can someone request a merge window for 16:30 UTC otherwise we'll wait till tomorrow.

ben: +1, will monitor CI and merge on green. ping me if anything blocks.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR #1432 — build: passing, tests: 12/13, flaky test identified: 'stream chunk sizing'.

mina: pushed fix for flaky test, added more logs. thanks all for the quick responses!

sam: approved, left comment re: changelog entry.

taylor: approved.

ben: approved.

mina: thanks everyone — merging after CI green and tagging release. :tada:
